Every label's total accepted net I+B must match its independently counted endpoint inventory change. Observed single-hop in/out counts must be at least the corresponding unique endpoint-ID counts. summaries: Report exact in/out, signed net and gross fraction carried by I separately by seed, chemistry, threshold and endpoint mask; label per-seed and total curves. No inference that the gross contribution necessarily has the sign or magnitude of net growth.
